'''Green Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of Green Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Green Leader.

==History==
===Rebel Alliance===
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Merrick Simms]] flew a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Green Leader while stationed at [[Anchorhead Base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he conducted trials for trainee pilots such as "[[Rookie One]]" through the nearby [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]].<ref name="RA">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref><ref name="RATOIG">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault: The Official Insider's Guide]]''</ref>

An [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Green Leader (Battle of Hoth)|pilot]] who escorted the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' past [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]] was designated Green Leader.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

After the Battle of Hoth, [[Stevan Makintay]] commanded a [[Green Squadron (Eyrie Base)|Green Squadron]] stationed at [[Eyrie Base]], and went by this call sign.<ref name="FP" />

[[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]] served as Green Leader in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], leading a [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|squadron]] of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] into combat during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], but was killed during the battle after his A-wing was fatally hit. However, Crynyd managed to steer his interceptor toward the unshielded bridge of the ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]'', destroying it and sending the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Dreadnought]] plummeting into the surface of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===New Republic===
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Green Squadron (New Republic)|Green Squadron]] escorted a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] led by the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Dewback's Burden]]'' to [[Bhuna Sound/Legends|Bhuna Sound]], where they were ambushed by [[Eiattu pirates|pirate]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]]. The [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] designated Green Leader was destroyed with the rest of the convoy.<ref name="Lando">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref>

Another Green Leader on patrol over [[Pinnacle Base]] encountered the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Defiance (MC90 Star Cruiser)|''Defiance'']], returning from a reconnaissance mission to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] in which it had sustained damage to its transponder, preventing the ship from broadcasting its identification codes.<ref name="DEa">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>

Green Squadron fought in the [[Battle of Calamari]],<ref name="CSWE" /> during which an X-wing pilot flying as Green Leader was killed in action by a [[TIE/D automated starfighter]].<ref name="DE3" />

Later, [[Green Leader (Destruction of the Pelagia)|another Green Leader]] was stationed in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottegan system]] when the troopship ''[[Pelagia]]'' [[Destruction of the Pelagia|was destroyed]] by a missile fired from the [[Galaxy Gun]].<ref name="EE">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref>

During an attempt to rescue [[Kir Kanos]] and [[Feena D'Asta]], an X-wing pilot designated Green Leader [[Attack on Grappa the Hutt's fortress|caused extensive damage]] to the [[Grappa's palace|palace]] of [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on the orders of Commander [[Mirith Sinn]].<ref name="CEII">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref>

[[Yakown Reth]] served as Green Leader during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
